camel_example: aliyun paimodelgallery GET /api/v2/modelgallery/models --region cn-hangzhou --Origin ModelScope --Task 'large-language-model' --Distillable true --PageSize 10 --Query Qwen --SupportedCompressionResource GP7V --SortBy GmtCreateTime --Deployable true --SupportedDistillationResource GP7V --DeepThink true --Conditions '[{"Operator":"LessThan","Column":"ParameterSize","Value":"1024"}]' --Demonstrable true --PageNumber 1 --SupportedTrainingResource GP7V --ModelSeries Qwen --FunctionCall true --Collections QuickStart --Trainable true --Order DESC --SupportedInferenceResource GP7V --SupportedEvaluationResource GP7V --ModelName 'Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507' --Compressible true --Evaluable true --ModelType LoRA --Tag '[{"Value":"v1","Key":"k1"}]' --Domain aigc --header "Content-Type=application/json" --version 2026-06-03 --force

Collection.description_en: The collection to which the model belongs. Models in ModelGallery belong to the QuickStart collection
Collection.description_zh: 模型所在集合。ModelGallery的模型所在集合为QuickStart

DeepThink.description_en: Indicates whether deep thinking is supported

Demonstrable.description_en: Indicates whether online experience is supported

Domain.description_en: The domain used to filter models within a specific domain. For example: aigc, nlp, cv, audio, biomedical, or other
Domain.description_zh: 配置领域来过滤该领域内的模型列表。例如：aigc、nlp、cv、audio、biomedical、other

GmtLatestVersionModified.description_en: The update time of the latest model version
GmtLatestVersionModified.description_zh: 模型最新版本更新时间

ModelSeries.description_en: The model series. PAI Optimized Model, Qwen, Wan-AI, GLM, Baichuan, DeepSeek, Kimi, MiniMax, Yi, InternLM, InternVL, OpenAI, NVIDIA, Gemma, Phi, dots_vlm, Llama, Mistral, Stable Diffusion, FLUX, Byte Dance, StepFun AI, ERNIE Bot, Tencent Hunyuan, or YOLO

ModelType.description_en: The model type. Valid values: LoRA, ComfyUIWorkFlow, Checkpoint, AI4DApp, AI4DTool, embeddings, or VAE

Origin.description_en: The model source used to filter models that belong to a specific community or organization. For example: ModelScope, Custom, Civitai, Artlab, PAI, LiblibAI, NIM, GitHub, EasyCV, or HuggingFace
Origin.description_zh: 配置模型源，来过滤属于该社区或组织的模型列表。例如：ModelScope、Custom、Civitai、Artlab、PAI、LiblibAI、NIM、GitHub、EasyCV、HuggingFace

SupportedCompressionResources.description_en: The supported compression resources, such as CPU, GPU, or GP7V. For example, if GP7V is specified, only models that support compression on GP7V resources are returned
SupportedCompressionResources.description_zh: 支持的压缩资源。CPU，GPU，GP7V等。如GP7V，则筛选压缩支持GP7V资源的模型

SupportedDistillationResources.description_en: The supported distillation resources, such as CPU, GPU, or GP7V. For example, if GP7V is specified, only models that support distillation on GP7V resources are returned
SupportedDistillationResources.description_zh: 支持的蒸馏资源。CPU，GPU，GP7V等。如GP7V，则筛选蒸馏支持GP7V资源的模型

SupportedEvaluationResources.description_en: The supported evaluation resources, such as CPU, GPU, or GP7V. For example, if GP7V is specified, only models that support evaluation on GP7V resources are returned
SupportedEvaluationResources.description_zh: 支持的评测资源。CPU，GPU，GP7V等。如GP7V时，则筛选支持GP7V资源的模型

SupportedInferenceResources.description_en: The supported deployment resources, such as CPU, GPU, or GP7V. For example, if GP7V is specified, only models that support deployment on GP7V resources are returned
SupportedInferenceResources.description_zh: 支持的部署资源。CPU，GPU，GP7V等。如GP7V，则筛选部署支持GP7V资源的模型

SupportedTrainingResources.description_en: The supported training resources, such as CPU, GPU, or GP7V. For example, if GP7V is specified, only models that support training on GP7V resources are returned
SupportedTrainingResources.description_zh: 支持的训练资源。CPU，GPU，GP7V等。如GP7V，则筛选训练支持GP7V资源的模型

Task.description_en: The task. For example: text-to-image-synthesis, large-language-model, multimodal-large-language-model, text-classification, embedding, audio-classification, text-to-video-synthesis, object-detection, text-to-speech, image-segmentation, image-classification, image-to-video-synthesis, image-captioning, video-classification, molecule-generation, content-security-detection, pose-estimation, ocr-recognition, text-generation, image-to-image-synthesis, zero-shot-classification, auto-speech-recognition, token-classification, summarization, protein-folding, digital-human, weather-simulation, text-translation, sequence-labeling, question-answering, other, ocr, medical-imaging, or amino-acid-prediction

description_en: Retrieves the list of models from ModelGallery
kebab_example: aliyun paimodelgallery list-model-gallery-models --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --order DESC --sort-by GmtCreateTime --model-name Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 --domain aigc --task large-language-model --origin ModelScope --model-type LoRA --collections QuickStart --model-series Qwen --demonstrable true --deployable true --supported-inference-resource GP7V --trainable true --supported-training-resource GP7V --evaluable true --supported-evaluation-resource GP7V --compressible true --supported-compression-resource GP7V --distillable true --supported-distillation-resource GP7V --deep-think true --function-call true --tag Value=v1 Key=k1 --conditions Operator=LessThan Column=ParameterSize Value=1024 --query Qwen --api-version 2026-06-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListModelGalleryModels

parameters.help_en: The page number of the model list. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 模型列表的页码。起始值为 1，默认为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of models to display on each page in a paged query. Settings this parameter for paging. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的模型数量，默认为 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order for the specified sort field in a paged query. This parameter is used for paging. Default value: ASC.

Valid values:
ASC: ascending order.
DESC: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，对指定的排序字段进行升序或降序。默认 ASC。

ASC：升序。 DESC：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The sort field for a paged query. This parameter is used for paging. Currently, the GmtCreateTime field is used for sorting. Valid values:

GmtCreateTime: the time when the model was created.
GmtLatestVersionModified: the time when the latest model version was updated.
OrderNumber: the ordinal number
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时的排序字段。目前使用 GmtCreateTime 字段用于排序。支持：

GmtCreateTime 模型创建时间
GmtLatestVersionModified 模型最新版本更新时间
OrderNumber 序号
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The model name. By default, fuzzy match is used to filter the model list. Enclose the value in double quotation marks for exact match. For example, "DeepSeek-V3.2" exactly matches the model DeepSeek-V3.2
parameters.help_zh: 配置模型名称，默认模糊匹配获取的模型列表。使用双引号为精确匹配，如"DeepSeek-V3.2"，则会精确匹配模型 DeepSeek-V3.2
parameters.name: model_name

parameters.help_en: The domain used to filter the model list. For example: aigc, nlp, cv, audio, biomedical, or other
